description: N58 piano lines by elaboration (docs/learned_workflow.md section 6f), driven by the N58 'Piano (D)' 1-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). Each track starts from one held A4 plus a frozen last note (A4) on the 2nd 8th of beat 4, held half a beat; each cycle adds one edit (split, join, new note, re-pitch, note to rest). Cycle order reversed: busy -> one held note. 16 tracks x 400 bars (400 one-bar cycles).
